home.heroTitle: The right tutor. A brighter future.
home.heroSub: Free online educational sessions, delivered by verified qualified volunteers to primary, intermediate, and secondary students.
home.trustBody: Every volunteer is reviewed and verified before appearing here. Guardians can see every session, and all communication stays inside the platform.
home.impactEmpty: Numbers will appear as the platform grows. We never display invented figures — every number here comes from real sessions recorded in the database.

footer.rights: AND MORE — a volunteer education platform

apply.title: Submit your volunteer application
apply.intro: Three short steps. We review every application carefully, and only verified volunteers appear.
apply.coc_text: I accept the platform's Code of Conduct and Child Safety policy.
apply.coc_required: Accepting the Code of Conduct is required.
apply.success_body: Our team will review it soon. Send us a WhatsApp message so we can follow up with you.
apply.wa_notice: WhatsApp is a third-party service — our team will see your number. Your application is saved in your account even without WhatsApp.
apply.wa_prefill: Hello, I would like to volunteer with AND MORE.

admin.title: Review volunteer applications
admin.decision_failed: Could not save the decision. Try again.

find.title: Find a volunteer tutor
find.intro: Everyone listed here is a verified volunteer: reviewed and approved before appearing.
find.empty: No volunteers match your current filters.

book.title: Request an educational session
book.intro: Pick the stage, subject, and a time that suits you. Your request is saved to your account, and our team confirms it with you.
book.subject: Subject
book.need: What do you need help with?
book.no_contact_hint: Do not share phone numbers or personal accounts here.
book.fill_required: Fill in stage, subject, a need of at least 10 characters, date, and time.
book.success_body: Send us a WhatsApp message so we can confirm your booking.
book.wa_notice: WhatsApp is a third-party service — our team will see your number. Your request is saved to your dashboard even without WhatsApp.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: We read every report seriously. High-severity reports reach the admins immediately.
report.desc_required: Write a description of at least 10 characters.
report.submit_failed: Could not send the report. Try again.
report.success_body: Thank you for your trust. Our team will review it and reach out if needed.
